content:
Overview

Joensuu is a city in North Karelia with a population of 76,000. A university city in the Finnish Lakeland, known for its proximity to Koli National Park and Orthodox heritage. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
